name: MovingWithPets

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about moving house.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative discussion about moving a house, with all the problems it may bring as well as new and unique opportunities.

variations.context: Moving with pets into an unfamiliar neighborhood

setting.relationship_dynamic: Pet owners preparing a move while minimizing disruption for their animals
setting.background: They are moving to a different neighborhood and have two pets that become stressed by changes in their environment
setting.conversation_style: Practical planning focused on continuity and reducing disruption

scenario_template.topic: Planning the move around the pets
scenario_template.note: They discuss how their pets typically react to travel, noise, and unfamiliar spaces
They identify beds, blankets, food, toys, and other familiar items that should not be buried in moving boxes
The animals react to the changing environment before moving day has even arrived
They ask the Assistant how to structure the move so the pets spend as little time around the moving activity as possible
Assistant suggests prioritizing a quiet, familiar setup when they arrive at the new home
They need to balance unpacking with giving the animal time to adjust
They focus on restoring feeding, sleeping, and play routines while gradually unpacking

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to complete a home move efficiently but has limited experience with moving logistics and can become overwhelmed when faced with many decisions, deadlines, or physical tasks at once

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help coordinate the move, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check plans, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar moving requirements

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Home moving assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for planning and executing a move, helps users prioritize tasks and deadlines, suggests efficient packing and organization strategies, and offers alternatives when time, space, budget, or moving resources are limited
